$comment: An example .claude/settings.json that wires both hooks in. Copy guard.js and subagent-guard.js to .claude/hooks/ in your repository, merge this into your settings, and commit both so every session inherits them. The permission lists are prefix matches on the first command; the hooks judge the whole line. onFailure: block means a hook that crashes blocks the call rather than letting it through.

env.$comment: Caps Claude Code can enforce itself. The subagent guard adds the one it cannot: a total per session. With no model pin, every subagent call has to name its model, and the guard makes sure it does.
